The '''Massa Family''' was a criminal organization on [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] that was run by [[Granz Niiliisi]]. They specialized in [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]], extortion, and black marketeering.<ref name="H&S" />
